parts.name: front-glass
parts.notes: Photo-informed blank glass surface; no photograph screen/UI content is drawn. Thickness and stack placement are estimates. Render plane sits 0.02 mm behind the manufacturer front-key tops (worldZ=8.50 mm), so all three real CAD keys remain visible. The previous8.55mm plane incorrectly covered them; its rejected position is retained in review limitations. Glass material/stack remains an estimate.

sourceTransform.note: Multi-file manufacturer OBJ bottom shell and STL front/side/button retain native coordinates. Global rigid X-rotation maps front+Y to+Z. The supplied single front key is repeated at x+12/+24mm matching the three equivalent photographed CAD openings. No shell deformation.

screen.basis: Image-informed window size/placement within manufacturer case; not an independently calibrated display stack.

limitations: Manufacturer exterior geometry only; exact product board/CPU/peripheral execution is unavailable.
Photograph-informed material colors are uncalibrated display approximations.
PCB UNKNOWN is an estimated blank placeholder, not a populated or manufacturing-ready board.
External connector/body inserts are photo-derived estimates where manufacturer CAD omits them.
No physical hardware measurements or flashing performed.

Official gallery lacks clean matching orthographic front/back/side views; selected independent product photos include packaging/scale/oblique views, so silhouette scores are not acceptance proof. Bottom drawing is linked by thev2.7page from aBASICv2.6 resource; applicability is recorded rather than inferred as identical electronics.
